AMD-PUR-2026-03_Amendment3_PurchasePolicy_DIRlimit.pdf: AMD-PUR-2026-03 reduces the direct purchase order limit in POL-PUR-001 §3.3 from £50,000 to £25,000 effective 2026-12-01, but the current limit remains £50,000 until 30 November 2026.

AMD-SUP-2026-02 Amendment 2 Supplier Policy.pdf: AMD-SUP-2026-02 replaces POL-SUP-003 §4.4 (which permitted UN 38.3 certificates issued within 24 months and not expired) with a stricter requirement that certificates must be issued within 12 months and valid for at least 60 days after order placement.

[[hr-conf-011]] today: Leeds stores remain active today, with consultation strictly confidential to the steering group | other: From 1 April 2027, all Leeds stores work is proposed to transfer to Manchester, putting six roles at risk

[[items-bat]] today: Battery pack suppliers must hold an active UN 38.3 test certificate uploaded and verified in Ledgerline before orders are placed, with ≥60 days validity remaining | other: Battery pack suppliers were permitted to provide a UN 38.3 test report within three months after the first purchase order

[[items-bat]] today: Lithium-cell parts requiring UN 38.3 certification include battery packs, hub motors, and chargers marked cell_safety = 1 | other: UN 38.3 certificates applied only to battery packs, while hub motors and chargers were explicitly excluded

[[pol-apr-002]] today: Gross approval limits including VAT are £250,000 for PUR-EXEC, £500,000 for PUR-SR, £1,000,000 for PUR-MGR, and £5,000,000 for PLANT-HEAD | other: Under superseded v2.0 (effective 2024-04-01), the limits were £200,000 for PUR-EXEC, £400,000 for PUR-SR, £750,000 for PUR-MGR, and £5,000,000 for PLANT-HEAD

[[pol-apr-002]] today: Version 3.0 was authored by D. Okafor and approved by Plant Head Henrik Weber on 2026-04-01 | other: Under superseded version 2.0, the document owner was the Plant head's office

findings.detail: [[pol-bat-004]] today: Battery packs are booked in Ledgerline to warehouse WH-MAN-STR | other: The legacy warehouse code WH-MAN-BAT was merged into WH-MAN-STR in 2019 and must not be used

[[pol-pur-001]] today: Direct purchase orders without a purchase request are permitted up to £50,000 gross value including VAT | other: From 1 December 2026, amendment AMD-PUR-2026-03 restricts direct orders to £25,000 or less

[[pol-pur-001]] today: Any purchase order placed at more than 2% above the contract rate requires the manager's written justification in the remarks | other: In superseded version 4.0, written justification was required only when exceeding the rate by more than 5%

[[pol-pur-001]] today: Direct purchase orders without a prior purchase request are permitted up to £50,000 gross value | other: In superseded version 3.0, direct purchase orders without a request were permitted only up to £30,000 gross value

[[pol-pur-001]] today: UN 38.3 test certificates are required for lithium-cell parts including battery packs, hub motors, chargers, and any item marked cell_safety = 1 | other: In superseded version 3.0, only battery packs required a UN 38.3 certificate, excluding hub motors and chargers

[[pol-sup-003]] today: A UN 38.3 certificate is valid only if issued within the last 12 months and valid for at least 60 days after the purchase order date | other: A UN 38.3 certificate was valid if issued within 24 months and its valid-to date had not passed

[[pol-tex-007]] today: Hotel ceilings are £140 outside London and £190 in London including breakfast; meal allowance is £35/day; claim deadline is 60 days on AP-EXP-09. | other: From 2027-01-01 (v3.0), hotel ceilings rise to £150 outside London and £210 in London, meal allowance rises to £40/day, claim deadline drops to 45 days, and written approval is required for exceeding hotel caps.

[[pol-tex-007]] today: Claims must be entered on screen AP-EXP-09 with receipts for items over £10 and manager approval. | other: From 2027-01-01 (v3.0), electronic claims route to departmental manager then purchase ledger clerk, with paper receipts and printed cover slips deposited in the finance tray.

[[role-plant-head]] today: Under POL-APR-002 v3.0, role PLANT-HEAD has a purchase approval limit of £5,000,000 gross including VAT per document. | other: Under superseded v2.0, role PLANT-HEAD held the same approval limit of £5,000,000 gross including VAT.
[[role-pur-exec]] today: The purchase approval limit for PUR-EXEC is £250,000 gross including VAT | other: PUR-EXEC approval limit was £200,000 gross including VAT

[[role-pur-exec]] today: A purchase executive initiates new vendor onboarding by preparing written quotations, justification, and duplicate search evidence | other: Purchase executives were authorized to propose new suppliers by collecting required onboarding documents, search results, and at least one written quote
[[role-pur-mgr]] today: Approval limit is £1,000,000 gross including VAT per document | other: Under POL-APR-002 v2.0 (2024), the approval limit was £750,000 gross including VAT

[[role-pur-sr]] today: The PUR-SR role has an approval limit of £500,000 gross including VAT per document | other: In POL-APR-002 v2.0, role PUR-SR held an approval limit of £400,000 gross including VAT

[[screen-ap-exp-09]] today: Claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense. | other: From 2027-01-01, claims must be entered within 45 days of the spend, and claims submitted after 45 days require exceptional sign-off from senior management.

[[screen-fin-cc-01]] today: Purchasing staff check FIN-CC-01 to confirm an active cost centre before raising requests or resolving held orders under current POL-PUR-001 v4.1 and SOP-PUR-002 v1.4 | other: Earlier superseded procedures specified consulting FIN-CC-01 under POL-PUR-001 v4.0 and SOP-PUR-002 v1.3

[[screen-pur-po-01]] today: Standard PO entry from approved requisitions uses order type STD and Source PR, mandating Fetch and manual VAT adjustments | other: Identical operational flow documented in earlier procedure version

[[screen-pur-por-05]] today: Approved purchase orders are released on PUR-POR-05 by pressing F9 to transition status from AP to RL | other: In superseded SOP-PUR-002 v1.3, approved purchase orders are released on PUR-POR-05 using key F9, moving status to RL

[[screen-pur-pr-01]] today: On PUR-PR-01, pressing F9 submits the requisition for departmental approval or immediate sign-off under SOP-PUR-002 v1.4 | other: Under superseded SOP-PUR-002 v1.3, pressing F9 submits the requisition for approval without reference to immediate sign-off

[[screen-pur-sup-01]] today: Screen PUR-SUP-01 creates active supplier records and blocks duplicate VAT numbers with ERR-SUP-0118. | other: Byte-identical duplicate source text states identical creation steps and error handling.

[[screen-pur-sup-01]] today: Screen PUR-SUP-01 creates active supplier records in Ledgerline following purchase manager onboarding approval under POL-SUP-003 v2.3. | other: Superseded POL-SUP-003 v2.2 previously governed creation and duplicate refusal under ERR-SUP-0118.

[[screen-pur-sup-03]] today: Proposers must search the supplier master by company name, city, and VAT registration number prior to compiling onboarding paperwork | other: Byte-identical copy of POL-SUP-003 v2.3 stating identical onboarding search requirement

[[screen-pur-sup-03]] today: Under POL-SUP-003 v2.3 and SOP-PUR-001 v3.1, search supplier master across company name, city, and VAT registration number, capturing output for onboarding file | other: Under superseded POL-SUP-003 v2.2, screen PUR-SUP-03 was used to search the supplier master by name, city, and VAT number before submitting a new supplier onboarding file

[[screen-supp-enq]] today: Screen SUPP-ENQ is not part of current procedures | other: In superseded SOP-PUR-001 v2.0, screen SUPP-ENQ was accessed under Ledgerline 6 menu Masters > Vendors to search the supplier list
[[screen-supp-ent]] today: Screen SUPP-ENT is no longer current for vendor onboarding | other: Screen SUPP-ENT was used to create new vendor accounts in SOP-PUR-001 v2.0

[[sop-pur-001]] today: Duplicate searches are performed on screen PUR-SUP-03 by short name, city, and VAT number | other: Searches were conducted on screen SUPP-ENQ via Ledgerline 6 menu Masters > Vendors
[[sop-pur-001]] today: Suppliers are created on screen PUR-SUP-01 using service sup_create | other: Suppliers were created on screen SUPP-ENT

[[sop-pur-001]] today: Suppliers of lithium-cell parts must provide a UN 38.3 test report issued within 12 months and valid for at least 60 days past the first order date prior to order placement | other: Battery pack suppliers were permitted to send a UN 38.3 report within three months after the first order
[[sop-pur-001]] today: Standard onboarding requires five working days (ten working days for lithium-cell suppliers) | other: Onboarding allowed three working days

[[sop-pur-002]] today: Pressing F3 (Fetch) after entering supplier and item on PUR-PO-01 is mandatory in Ledgerline 7.2.3, failing which save is refused with ERR-SCR-0221 | other: In v1.3 Fetch was not mandatory to avoid ERR-SCR-0221

[[sop-qua-002]] today: Damaged packs are placed into an outdoor fire-rated quarantine locker/external container using a fire-retardant transit drum and vermiculite bedding | other: Damaged packs are moved to the red quarantine bin inside fire cell BAT-Z4
